turns.user_message: How much does extra internet cost?

input.query: extra internet cost additional internet blocks price

result.query: extra internet cost additional internet blocks price

matches.heading: What is the cost of extra internet?
matches.reference: §8.1 What is the cost of extra internet?
matches.text: Each additional 10 GB block beyond 20 GB costs $10. Partially used blocks are rounded up. See Section 3.2.

matches.heading: Additional internet blocks
matches.text: Each additional 10 GB block costs $10. A partially used additional block is charged as a full block. For example, 20 GB costs $50; 21 GB costs $60; 30 GB costs $60; 35 GB costs $70.

matches.heading: Additional minutes
matches.text: Each additional 1,000-minute block costs $10. A partially used additional block is charged as a full block. For example, 1,001 minutes costs $10 in phone charges; 2,001 minutes costs $20.

turns.final_answer: Extra internet costs $10.00 for each additional 10 GB block beyond your 20 GB included allowance. A partially used block is charged as a full block. For example, 21 GB costs $60.00 in total for internet, and 30 GB also costs $60.00. (§3.2 Additional internet blocks, §8.1 What is the cost of extra internet?)
